parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

opts.a: a mixture of earth and water

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: I’ve just been told the hotel lift is broken, so we’ll have to carry our luggage up the ____ .
Electric ____ are very uncommon in this country. Everyone just heats water for tea on the hob.
Almost everything you heard Charles say during the meeting was a ____ . That man never tells the truth.
Nobody woke me up this morning and I ____ ; I didn’t wake up till almost ten o’clock and arrived for work two hours late!
Look at that cat. It’s sleeping in a really strange ____ with its front legs above its head and its back legs completely straight.
We ____ breakfast in a hurry and immediately ran to the train station.
I’d like you to start working as ____ as you arrive. Don’t spend the first hour chatting!
Of course I can roast a chicken. You should have more faith ____ my cooking skills!
When’s your boyfriend arriving? I can’t wait ____ him!
____ Paula use to live in Spain before she moved to England? She speaks the language so well.
The police officer said he ____ me if I didn’t do exactly what he said.
We would have gone climbing if ____ any ropes with us.
There is a lift in the building, but the property we’re going to look at is on the ground ____ , so you wouldn’t need to use it.
Agata ____ about ten minutes trying to open the ketchup bottle but couldn’t.
This summer holiday, you’re happy to visit somewhere you’ve been to before, ____ ?

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: Last year, our company made a small losing, but this year, we’ve made a very healthy profit.
Three of our players hurted themselves during the game on Tuesday, but we hope they’ll all be fine for the next match.
If I were you, I’d book an appointment to see the doctor about your earach; it’s getting worse, isn’t it?
I don’t know why we bought Chloe a bicycle. She’s only rides it once or twice since we got it; it’s just there in the garden getting wet.
They had asked us in several previous occasions not to park outside their house, so I wasn’t surprised when they complained to us about it.
As there was no future in agricultural work, Solomon encouraged his sons for moving to the industrial north of the country to find work.
Which do you consider being the most important: health, money or love?
The children played turns to see who could say the English alphabet the fastest!
Eduardo has offered me £100 by exchange for helping him to move house.
I’m sorry but this plan doesn’t look like sense. We need to go away and think about it more.

parts.text: The three forms of “choose” are “choose, chose, chosen”. The past of “ride” is “rode”. The past of “fall” is “fell”. The three forms of “blow” are “blow, blew, blown”. Books are made of paper. “Ought” is the only exception to this rule. We call the words “who”, “which” and “that” relative pronouns. The expression “every now and again” means “sometimes but not often”. Dolphins are mammals, not fish. I’m losing weight by going to the gym. Could you lend me a hand getting this piano up the stairs, please? Geoff’s dinner consisted of baked beans and a slice of toast. We can meet any time next week. Let me know which day you’d prefer.
